acceptance.criterion: AC-60 (FR-83): when a non-build session's running window elapses with no store change, the Overview's 'Running now' tile shows 'session idle' within 60 s of the header showing Idle
acceptance.evidence: The minute timer compares clockState (forecast passed, isLive, scopeLive) with what renderAll last drew and redraws once when it differs, so the tile changes on the same tick as the header. Page check 'running window: ...' drives Date.now from 5 to 9 to 11 minutes after the session's last activity: Active/'session active', then Idle/'session idle' on the same tick, and no further redraw on the next tick. RED on HEAD.

acceptance.criterion: AC-62 (FR-85): the app bar and Overview render on every load; time-boxed investigation, first render robust if the store is slow, fails or is absent
acceptance.evidence: Findings from reading the load path (not reproduced in Chrome): (1) Most likely cause: the Google Fonts <link rel=stylesheet> was parser-inserted at the top of the page content. Such a stylesheet is render-blocking for everything after it and script-blocking for the inline script, so while fonts.googleapis.com stalled, neither the app bar nor the script could paint or run: a blank page until the request finished or timed out. A reload usually serves the CSS from cache, which matches 'occasional, fixed by a reload'. Fix: the script inserts the stylesheet (not render- or script-blocking), in a try/catch, with the fallback sans until the fonts arrive. (2) A claude.use('db') that rejected or threw became an unhandled rejection and left the page on 'Connecting' for good. Now it is caught, warned and shown as Offline. (3) forecastIsPast ran outside renderAll's per-tab try/catch, so one throw escaped apply(). Now it is guarded. (4) The first paint already ran before the store: apply() is synchronous, before the store promise, and each tab is in its own try/catch. Pinned. Page checks: fonts via script (RED on HEAD); store absent (3 forms); store rejects or throws (RED on HEAD); late store with a timer tick while waiting. The 20-load live Chrome check is orchestrator-owned (see not_done).
